terms.gloss: surround with a hedge or fence, hedge in, fence in, enclose
evidence: Plaut. Curc. 1.1.36: dum nē per fundum saeptum faciās sēmitam (Lewis & Short)
Cic. Tusc. 5.64: saeptum undique et vestītum vepribus et dūmētīs indāgāvī sepulcrum (Lewis & Short)

phrases.latin: dum nē per fundum saeptum faciās sēmitam
phrases.english: so long as you don’t make a path through fenced land

phrases.latin: saeptum undique et vestītum vepribus et dūmētīs indāgāvī sepulcrum
